about: Labels something with one short word or a count, set off from what it labels.

marked.about: A badge led by a mark. A mark is the second thing a status is told by, after the colour, and a reader who cannot tell the four hues apart reads nothing from a row that differs by hue alone. A mark a caller puts in is drawn one em square, so it sits at the badge's own words at every size.
marked.title: Marks

radius.about: Every corner at every size, on a count. Numbers are tabular, so a column of counts holds its width as the counts change.
radius.title: Corners and sizes

status.about: Every status in every look. A badge whose meaning is in its colour needs that meaning in words.
status.title: Statuses

title: Badge

variant.about: Every look at every size. The look is flat, so a badge does not repaint under a pointer.
variant.title: Looks and sizes
